rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis proposes an alumina coating, while the target uses 3D ink extrusion printing, hydride decomposition, sintering, and a silicide coating. These are fundamentally different kinds of interventions.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis specifies air at 800 °C for 5 hours, whereas the target uses vacuum sintering at 1400 °C, water quenching from 1500 °C, and a flowing hydrogen environment. The conditions are entirely different.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis relies on a physical barrier (alumina) to slow oxygen diffusion, while the target uses interstitial strengthening from controlled oxygen uptake, phase stabilization via quenching, and a self-healing silicide coating. These are different classes of mechanism.
rationale.outcome_agreement: Both predict reduced oxidation and preserved mechanical properties, but the target specifies a ~700x reduction in parabolic rate constant and a metastable beta-BCC phase, while the hypothesis only predicts a general reduction in oxidation. The property and direction are the same, but the specifics differ.
